summary: The Metals Royalty Company Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting an extension of the closing date for its previously announced acquisition of an additional 1.0% gross overriding production royalty in the Mesabi Metallics iron ore project. The closing was extended to August 15, 2026, with an option to further extend to August 21, 2026. This is a routine update to an existing royalty purchase agreement, not a new special situation. The filing outlines project progress and forward-looking statements, but no new material terms were disclosed. The extension is administrative, and the filing does not constitute an offer or solicitation.
